test_framework: pytest with conftest.py fixtures in tests/ directory
build_command: python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text()) for f in pathlib.Path('posframework').rglob('*.py')]"
test_command: python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text()) for f in pathlib.Path('tests').rglob('*.py')]"
verification_instructions: Since we cannot install dependencies (scapy, manuf, pyyaml) in this environment, use AST parsing to validate all Python files have valid syntax. Run python3 -c to parse each new/modified file.
setup_instructions: Cannot install packages - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Use AST validation only.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - no pip install, no Docker. Only pre-installed Python 3.12 is available with no packages. All verification must use AST parsing (python3 -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open("file.py").read())'). Cannot run pytest or import posframework modules.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Use type hints. Include docstrings. Cross-platform where applicable (IS_LINUX, IS_WINDOWS checks).
key_patterns: MonitorManagerInterface is the abstract base class. LinuxMonitorManager uses iw/ip commands. ChipMonitorManager detects by OUI. LinuxInterfaceDiscovery in interface_manager.py already reads /sys/class/net, iw dev, ethtool for driver/chipset. ReconEngine has self._monitor_manager and uses setup_monitor_mode(). WiresharkCapture in wireshark_capture.py wraps tshark CLI. Modules export via posframework/__init__.py.
directory_structure: posframework/ - main package with config.py, recon.py, monitor_mode.py, interface_manager.py, wireshark_capture.py, __init__.py, native/ (C bindings), tools/ (external tool integrations), plugins/. tests/ - pytest tests. Root has README.md, requirements.txt, setup.py, pytest.ini.
